posts.title: A Love Letter to Kotlin's sealed interface
posts.description: I’ve been writing Android apps in Kotlin for some 7 years now, and in the last couple years I’ve really come to appreciate how its features enable building robust systems. One feature in specific is usually central to what I come up with: the sealed interface . posts.title: Having an Upcoming Thing while Autistic
posts.description: In late 2023 I identified I’m probably autistic 1 .
